Author: Suuria
Name: EasyCrucible
Description: Beastmaster helper for the Crucible of the Unbroken: recommends the best familiars for every space and the board roster, frames them directly in the game's team selection, rates treasure and shop items, reads your captured familiars automatically and shows where to capture missing ones.
Punchline: Which familiars to bring into each Crucible of the Unbroken space.

Author: Suuria
Name: Funny Duty Roulett Plugin
Description: Verbindet sich über deine PlayerID mit Funny Duty Roulette, zeigt alle Job-Zuweisungen der aktuellen Session und prüft live, ob die Party bereits auf diese Jobs gewechselt ist.
Punchline: Zeigt die ausgelosten Jobs und den Live-Jobstatus deiner Party.

Author: Suuria
Name: Relic Tracker
Description: A compact checklist for combat relic weapon stages and the independent Anemos and Elemental Armor routes.
Punchline: Track FFXIV relic weapons and Eureka armor across jobs.
